Good evening, everyone, and welcome on board. My name is Karen and I am here with you today. In a few minutes we start the dinner service. Tonight we have chicken with rice, or pasta with tomato. If you have a food allergy, please tell me now, before the service. And if you do not understand something, please say sorry, can you repeat that, and I say it again, more slowly. That is not a problem for me. Thank you, and have a good flight.

Hello, this is a message from the Park Hotel in London. We have your reservation for four people, for seven nights. Your room is on the third floor, and it is ready after two in the afternoon. Breakfast is from seven to ten in the morning. The reception is open all day and all night, so you can call us at any time. If you need help with the bags, or a taxi, just ask at the desk. We speak English very slowly for our visitors, and we are happy to repeat. See you very soon.
